mechanism_narrative: A rise in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 3% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL YoY > 3% does not correlate with subsequent tightening cycles.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE increase > 0.5% does not correlate with subsequent economic weakness.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a recessionary environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or GDPC1 decline does not correlate with subsequent recessionary periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% in one month signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or INDPRO decline > 2% does not correlate with subsequent supply chain issues.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 300,000 in one month signals strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or PAYEMS increase > 300,000 does not correlate with subsequent economic growth.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in real GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) signals robust economic demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint increase in GDPC1 and HOUST does not correlate with subsequent economic demand.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is rising, it signals a tightening monetary policy with economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the joint condition of high FEDFUNDS and rising UNRATE does not correlate with subsequent negative returns.
